summary: Created FakeTagsManager: implements all 20 ITagsManager members with no-op/configurable returns. RaiseDataChanged() helper fires DataChanged synchronously. Cycle guards return false by default (configurable). TagList/CategoryList settable for test scaffolding.

summary: All 5 acceptance criteria verified and met.

AC1: FakeTagsManager implements all 23 ITagsManager members (properties, event, initialisation, 4 tag mutations, 3 category mutations, 2 grant mutations, 4 association methods, 3 query methods, 2 cycle guards). No NotImplementedException anywhere. Build confirms.
AC2: FakeMoviePropertiesService.WasShowCalled is false by default (bool default); set to true in ShowAsync. LastViewModel captures argument. Verified in source.
AC3: RaiseDataChanged() calls DataChanged?.Invoke(this, EventArgs.Empty) — synchronous invocation, no Task.Run or Post. Verified in source.
AC4: 288 App.Tests pass, 0 fail, 0 errors, 0 warnings.

AC5: FakeTagsManager.cs imports VideoIndexer.Core.Abstractions and VideoIndexer.Core.Models only. FakeMoviePropertiesService.cs imports VideoIndexer.App.Services and VideoIndexer.App.ViewModels only. No Infrastructure namespace in either file.

comments.note: FakeTagsManager mutation methods (DeleteTagAsync, MergeTagAsync, UpdateTagAsync, etc.) are no-ops and do not call RaiseDataChanged. Tests that rely on downstream DataChanged effects must call FakeTagsManager.RaiseDataChanged() explicitly. This is the standard fake pattern but worth noting in test documentation.
FakeTagsManager is complete and clean. All 23 interface members implemented with no stubs. Configurable return values for all query methods. Build + 288 tests all passing.
